aoi_set.note: These 20 original polygons differ from the team app's 18 rectangular zones. Match geometry, not just region names. No app data was replaced.

nisar.dataset: NASA-ISRO NISAR L2 GCOV PROVISIONAL V1
nisar.contents: AOI subset arrays, verified 30m block statistics, inherited display images, CMR metadata.

aggregation.aggregation: mean valid linear gamma0 in each 3x3 native block, equal mean of valid blocks, then 10*log10

nisar.attribution: NASA / ISRO NISAR, distributed by ASF DAAC
nisar.display_note: WebP images are inherited display layers and were not regenerated by the numerical verification processor.

hls.selection: Five regions, three representative dates per product; not the complete 2026 archive.
hls.indices_origin: Locally calculated from reflectance; not downloaded HLS-VI products.
hls.source_index: Zero-based index into the corresponding sources.stac.json items.
hls.qa_rule: Exclude Fmask=255, cloud/adjacent/shadow/snow bits 1/2/3/4 and aerosol bits 6-7=3. Water retained. Exclude negative or missing index inputs and zero denominators.
hls.aoi_comparison_rule: An index is null for comparison if its valid AOI fraction is below 0.8. This is a screening heuristic, not accuracy.
hls.attribution: NASA HLS v2.0 / LP DAAC; Microsoft Planetary Computer distribution

sentinel2.resampling: Spectral bands averaged from 10m to 20m; SCL retained at 20m.
sentinel2.scaling_scope: Only the 13 verified, already-harmonized Earth Search COG source tiles in this package. Do not apply the original STAC offset -0.1 again.

jrc_water.dataset: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 occurrence
jrc_water.note: Historical context, not 2026 flood/river ground truth; includes reservoirs.

power.three_day_sum: Labelled observation day and preceding two LST days; not 72 hours preceding the satellite overpass.
power.note: Coarse-grid regional precipitation, not a local rain gauge or causal proof.

worldcover.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

dem.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved

dem_quality.worldcover: 2021 land-cover statistics and display images, not a 2026 classification or original 10 m raster.
dem_quality.dem: 72x72 resampled display grid; not an original 30 m analysis raster. Some edge values are suspect; quantitative elevation use requires re-extraction with nodata-aware resampling.

boundaries.note: Inherited approximate display geometry, not an authoritative/legal DMZ boundary.

cross_dataset_limits: Actual acquisition dates differ between sensors; nearest dates are not simultaneous.
HLS narrow-NIR NDVI and the separate Sentinel-2 broad-NIR NDVI must not be concatenated as one identical series.
GeoTIFFs are project-area subsets or derived products, not complete original tiles.
No synthetic observations or gap filling were introduced.
ai_assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted collection/processing validation and packaging. Satellite observations were not AI-generated.
